met_analysis:
An upper air cyclonic circulation lies over Gulf of Thailand & neighbourhood and extends upto 7.6 km above mean sea level. it is likely to emergence in Andaman Sea around 11th October. Under its influence, a low- pressure area is likely to form over the Southeast Bay of Bengal around 13th October.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over north Bangladesh & adjoining Assam now lies over north Bangladesh & neighbourhood and extends upto 3.1 km above mean sea level.
The trough from north Bangladesh & adjoining Assam to Telangana, now runs from west Assam to Telangana across north Bangladesh, Sub-Himalayan West Bengal & Sikkim, Jharkhand, Odisha and Chhattisgarh at 5.8 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over East Uttar Pradesh & neighbourhood persists and now lies at 1.5 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Haryana & adjoining northwest Uttar Pradesh now lies over south Haryana & neighbourhood at 0.9 km above mean sea level.
The trough from Comorin area to Marathwada now runs from Comorin area to North Interior Karnataka across Tamil Nadu, South Interior Karnataka at 0.9 km above mean sea level.
The Western Disturbance as a cyclonic circulation over north Pakistan & neighbourhood at 3.1 km above mean sea level persists.
An upper air cyclonic circulation lies over east Assam & neighbourhood at 1.5 km above mean sea level.
